text_block_list.text: No bear! Defeated by the crane game!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It really is so exciting! The moment the 
crane picked up the plushie, my heart was 
racing!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It was a close one, but I'm so relieved we 
could bring the plushie home! Thank you so 
much, YES!
